/// One step from the root of a converted value.
public data PathPart
  Field(String)
  Index(Integer)
  Key(String)
end data

/// A conversion failure. `path` runs from the outermost container to the failure.
@extensible
public record ConversionError
  path: List[PathPart]
  expected: String
  found: String
  reason: String
end record

/// Builds a relative conversion failure without copying input payloads.
public function error(expected: String, found: String, reason: String) -> ConversionError
  return ConversionError(path: [], expected: expected, found: found, reason: reason)
end function

/// Adds an outer path component to a relative failure.
public function prepend(part: PathPart, error: ConversionError) -> ConversionError
  return ConversionError(..error, path: List.prepend(xs: ConversionError.path(error), x: part))
end function

/// Requires an object before decoding any record fields.
public function decodeObject(value: Json.Value) -> Result[Map[String, Json.Value], ConversionError]
  return match value with
    case Json.Value.Object(members) -> Result.Ok(members)
    case _ -> Result.Error(error(expected: "object", found: kind(value), reason: "wrong JSON kind"))
  end match
end function

/// Decodes a present field or uses an explicit missing-field conversion, adding its field path.
public function decodeField[T](members: Map[String, Json.Value], key: String, decode: function(value: Json.Value) -> Result[T, ConversionError], decodeMissing: function() -> Result[T, ConversionError]) -> Result[T, ConversionError]
  bind result <- match Map.get(m: members, k: key) with
    case Option.Some(value) -> decode(value)
    case Option.None -> decodeMissing()
  end match
  return Result.mapError(r: result, f: lambda(error) return prepend(part: PathPart.Field(key), error: error) end lambda)
end function

/// Fails for a required missing field; the caller adds its field path.
public function missing[T]() -> Result[T, ConversionError]
  return Result.Error(error(expected: "present field", found: "missing", reason: "required field is missing"))
end function

/// Rejects the first unexpected object key in key order, after all fields succeeded.
/// Uses a Key path so Show quotes and escapes the input key.
public function rejectExtra(members: Map[String, Json.Value], keys: List[String]) -> Result[Unit, ConversionError]
  return rejectExtraFrom(remaining: Map.keys(members), keys: keys, i: 0)
end function

function rejectExtraFrom(remaining: List[String], keys: List[String], i: Integer) -> Result[Unit, ConversionError]
  return match List.get(xs: remaining, i: i) with
    case Option.None -> Result.Ok(())
    case Option.Some(key) ->
      if List.contains(xs: keys, x: key) then
        rejectExtraFrom(remaining: remaining, keys: keys, i: i + 1)
      else
        Result.Error(prepend(part: PathPart.Key(key), error: error(expected: "known field", found: "extra key", reason: "unexpected object key")))
      end if
  end match
end function

/// Encodes a finite Float without implicit numeric conversion.
public function encodeFloat(value: Float) -> Result[Json.Value, ConversionError]
  if not finite(value) then
    return Result.Error(error(expected: "finite float", found: "non-finite float", reason: "JSON cannot represent NaN or infinity"))
  end if
  return Result.Ok(Json.Value.Float(value))
end function

/// Decodes only the JSON float kind; rejects NaN and infinity.
public function decodeFloat(value: Json.Value) -> Result[Float, ConversionError]
  return match value with
    case Json.Value.Float(x) ->
      if finite(x) then
        Result.Ok(x)
      else
        Result.Error(error(expected: "finite float", found: "non-finite float", reason: "JSON cannot represent NaN or infinity"))
      end if

public record Person
  displayName: String
  address: Address.Address
  nickname: Option[String]
  scores: List[Map[String, Float]]
  active: Boolean
  count: Integer
end record

/// Decodes Person in declaration order, then rejects the first extra key.
public function decodePerson(value: Json.Value) -> Result[Person, Codec.ConversionError]
  bind deriveMembers <- try Codec.decodeObject(value)
  bind deriveField0 <- try Codec.decodeField(members: deriveMembers, key: "display_name", decode: Codec.decodeString, decodeMissing: Codec.missing)
  bind deriveField1 <- try Codec.decodeField(members: deriveMembers, key: "address", decode: Address.decodeAddress, decodeMissing: Codec.missing)
  bind deriveField2 <- try Codec.decodeField(members: deriveMembers, key: "nickname", decode: Codec.decodeOption(value: _, decode: Codec.decodeString), decodeMissing: lambda() return Result.Ok(Option.None) end lambda)
  bind deriveField3 <- try Codec.decodeField(members: deriveMembers, key: "scores", decode: Codec.decodeList(value: _, decode: Codec.decodeMap(value: _, decode: Codec.decodeFloat)), decodeMissing: Codec.missing)
  bind deriveField4 <- try Codec.decodeField(members: deriveMembers, key: "active", decode: Codec.decodeBoolean, decodeMissing: Codec.missing)
  bind deriveField5 <- try Codec.decodeField(members: deriveMembers, key: "count", decode: Codec.decodeInteger, decodeMissing: Codec.missing)
  bind _ <- try Codec.rejectExtra(members: deriveMembers, keys: ["display_name", "address", "nickname", "scores", "active", "count"])
  return Result.Ok(Person(displayName: deriveField0, address: deriveField1, nickname: deriveField2, scores: deriveField3, active: deriveField4, count: deriveField5))
end function

end function

/// Decodes Address in declaration order, then rejects the first extra key.
public function decodeAddress(value: Json.Value) -> Result[Address, Codec.ConversionError]
  bind deriveMembers <- try Codec.decodeObject(value)
  bind deriveField0 <- try Codec.decodeField(members: deriveMembers, key: "city", decode: Codec.decodeString, decodeMissing: Codec.missing)
  bind _ <- try Codec.rejectExtra(members: deriveMembers, keys: ["city"])
  return Result.Ok(Address(city: deriveField0))
end function

def generate_json(target, inventory, imports):
    """Generate ordinary Result-based JSON conversions from resolved types."""
    codec = imports.require('Benitoite.Json.Codec', 'Codec')
    js = imports.require('Benitoite.Json', 'Json')
    template = Template(target, inventory, imports)
    fail, reference = template.fail, template.reference
    resolved, custom, type_name = template.resolved, template.custom, template.type_name
    result_type = lambda value: f'Result[{value}, {codec}.ConversionError]'

    def converter(ty, operation, field):
        tag = ty['tag']

error_type = 'Benitoite.Json.Codec.ConversionError'
        json_type = 'Benitoite.Json.Value'
        enc = custom(field, 'encode', ty, f'Benitoite.Result.Result[{json_type}, {error_type}]')
        dec = custom(field, 'decode', json_type, f'Benitoite.Result.Result[{ty}, {error_type}]')
        missing = custom(field, 'decodeMissing', None, f'Benitoite.Result.Result[{ty}, {error_type}]')
        if enc is None:
            enc = converter(field['type'], 'encode', field)
            dec = converter(field['type'], 'decode', field)
            if field['type']['tag'] == 'option':
                missing = 'lambda() return Result.Ok(Option.None) end lambda'
        if dec is not None and target['config'].get('fields', {}).get(field['name'], {}).get('decode'):
            configured = target['config']['fields'][field['name']]['decode']
            if target['customFunctions'][configured]['signature']['params'][0]['name'] != 'value':
                adapter = f'derive_{decode_name}_{index}'
                adapters.append(f'function {adapter}(value: {js}.Value) -> {result_type(type_name(field["type"]))}\n'
                                f'  return {dec}(value)\nend function\n\n')
                adapter_names.append(adapter)
                dec = adapter
        missing = missing or f'{codec}.missing'
        # All local names are generated, independent of user field spellings.
        local = f'deriveField{index}'
        encodes.append(f'  bind {local} <- try Result.mapError(r: ({enc})({name}.{field["name"]}(value)), '
                       f'f: lambda(error) return {codec}.prepend(part: {codec}.PathPart.Field({literal}), error: error) end lambda)\n')
        decodes.append(f'  bind {local} <- try {codec}.decodeField(members: deriveMembers, key: {literal}, decode: {dec}, decodeMissing: {missing})\n')
        members.append(f'Pair({literal}, {local})')
        fields.append(f'{field["name"]}: {local}')
    body = (''.join(adapters) + f'/// Encodes {name} in declaration order, returning the first relative conversion failure.\n'
            f'{prefix}function {encode_name}(value: {name}) -> {result_type(js + ".Value")}\n'
            + ''.join(encodes)
            + f'  return Result.Ok({js}.Value.Object(Map.fromList([{", ".join(members)}])))\nend function\n\n'
            + f'/// Decodes {name} in declaration order, then rejects the first extra key.\n'
            + f'{prefix}function {decode_name}(value: {js}.Value) -> {result_type(name)}\n'
            + f'  bind deriveMembers <- try {codec}.decodeObject(value)\n'
            + ''.join(decodes)
            + f'  bind _ <- try {codec}.rejectExtra(members: deriveMembers, keys: ['
            + ', '.join(string_literal(keys.get(f['name'], f['name'])) for f in target['fields'])
            + '])\n'
            + f'  return Result.Ok({name}({", ".join(fields)}))\nend function\n')
    return Generated(body, (encode_name, decode_name, *adapter_names))
